basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old software engineer based in Austin, Texas with a keen interest in hair restoration and fitness. By day, I work at a tech startup, and by night, I'm usually analyzing my diet or diving into video game lore. Married with a love for Japanese cuisine, I often spend my weekends exploring new restaurants. I typically browse Reddit during the evenings after work and occasionally during lunch breaks.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in computer science from the University of Texas, I have a strong analytical mindset. My interest in hair transplants started after a friend shared his successful journey. Since then, I've researched extensively through forums and medical articles. My knowledge of calorie tracking comes from years of self-teaching and using various apps to manage my own fitness goals.
